description: Evaluate a single lifting set's piecewise Wathan estimated 1RM (e1RM), sex/bodyweight/age-adjusted strength score (`0–100`), population tier (`untrained` to `elite`), and kg needed for the next tier. Stateless public calculator (no auth required, per-IP fair-use rate limits). Use to benchmark relative strength standards; to prescribe `reps @ RPE` working loads, gym barbell plate loading, or Karvonen Zone 2 heart rate, use `plates_zone2` instead.

age.description: Optional athlete age in years (13–90) for masters/youth age-coefficient adjustment.

bodyweight_kg.description: Athlete bodyweight in kg (included in total system load for `dip`, `pull_up`, `chin_up` and allometric scoring).

reps.description: Completed repetitions in the set (1–20; Wathan curve caps extrapolation beyond 10 reps).

sex.description: Biological sex reference curve (`male` or `female`) for relative strength normalization.

weight_kg.description: External load lifted in kg (ADDED belt/vest load for `dip`, `pull_up`, `chin_up`; total bar load otherwise).

name: strength_benchmark

app_url.description: Deep link to inspect this calculation interactively in STRUGGL.

connect_url.description: URL to connect a stateful STRUGGL athlete ledger via OAuth 2.1 or token.

e1rm_kg.description: Piecewise Wathan estimated 1RM in kg (added belt load for calisthenics).

methodology.description: Peer-reviewed sports-science equation and STRUGGL pillar provenance.

next_tier.description: Target `tier`, `e1rm_needed_kg`, and `kg_to_go` for the next classification (null when `elite`).

onboarding.description: OAuth 2.1 connector metadata explaining what longitudinal state unlocking adds.

score.description: Floored allometric strength score from 0 to 100.

title: Strength e1RM & Population Tier Benchmark
